newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says Kurdish rebels kill four militiamen.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says Kurdish rebels kill four militiamen.

text.p: Kurdish rebels have killed four members of Turkey's state-sponsored militia near the border with Iraq where there has been a build-up of Turkish troops, a top security official said on Wednesday.
The military official told Reuters the four village guards were killed in a clash with Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas in the province of Hakkari.

Witnesses said there had been a build-up of troops and armaments near Turkey's border with Iraq. The military keeps a strong presence in the area to prevent incursions by PKK rebels based in northern Iraq and on occasions Turkish troops have crossed the border to attack rebel camps there.
More than 22,000 people have died in clashes since the PKK began an armed struggle with the military for autonomy in the southeast of the country in 1984.
